messages:
Kayla: quick heads-up — the API reference POST /v1/predict OpenAPI example now uses `inputs: [{text: string}]`, but several curl/js/py/go snippets still show `prompt: "..."`. customers are copy-pasting and hitting 400s.
Sam: yikes. saw a ticket this morning. thanks for catching.
Miguel: is this only the api-ref page or other model pages too?
Kayla: api-ref (rendered at /docs/api/predict) mainly; model runbooks look ok. the OpenAPI schema was updated to support batching but hand-edited examples weren't migrated.
Priya: python SDK accepts both shapes for now, but docs showing `prompt` will confuse folks. recommend canonical examples use `inputs` and keep one legacy `prompt` example with a deprecation notice.
Miguel: agreed. i'll open a WIP PR that: updates openapi.yaml examples, runs tools/docs-gen, replaces manual snippets (curl/py/js/go), adds an SSE streaming example for batched inputs, and includes a short migration note.
Tim: make sure to run the docs linter locally after regen — CI fails if generated artifacts disagree with committed openapi samples.
Kayla: proposed checklist for PR: 1) update OpenAPI examples to batched `inputs` 2) run tools/docs-gen and commit generated files 3) update manual snippets (curl, python, js, go) 4) add SSE/EventSource sample that accumulates partial tokens across events 5) add migration note "prompt -> inputs" with curl+py migration examples 6) add SDK changelog entry about accepting both shapes for one minor release 7) add internal ticket for product comms and deprecation timeline.
Priya: i'll draft the SSE parsing example (EventSource parsing JSON and appending `payload.delta_tokens` until `payload.final === true`). will also add a short Go batch snippet using an explicit Inputs struct with json tags.
Miguel: PR (draft): github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4380 — includes snapshot test for rendered code blocks so we notice formatting regressions.
DevEx: quick UX nit — call out in the migration note that examples show both single-item batch and multi-item batch; include a one-liner: "Both `prompt` and `inputs` accepted until 2025-01-15." makes timeline explicit.
Sam: sounds good. after merge we should post a short update in #product-updates and add the migration note to release notes.
docs-bot: preview available at https://deploy-preview-4380--docs.redwood.ai (note: preview may show mixed examples until docs-gen commit is applied).
Kayla: tagging reviewers @Sam @Priya @Tim. please review the draft by EOD Wednesday if possible.
Sam: ack, i'll review tomorrow AM.
Priya: pushed the SSE and Go example drafts to the PR. left a comment about naming `Inputs` vs `PromptItem`.
Miguel: thanks — will iterate on naming and merge after CI and a quick devex sanity check.
Sam: thanks team — this should cut down the incoming support noise.
